verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents its own grant-issuance capability: awards can be granted one by one, with contracts created, signed and shared, and granting, document and signature workflows can be automated. Nothing in the evidence shows a board approval flow or 409A valuation or strike-price compliance, so only the issuance part of the end-to-end story is supported. Missing for 10: documented board approval workflow, 409A valuation and compliant strike-price setting, evidence these run as one end-to-end flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow

citations.quote: Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.
Automate your granting, document and signature workflows in bulk to make expansion easy.
